subject: Request to change meeting format: convert intro demo to engineering scoping workshop

Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acme-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Change of plan — can we convert intro demo into a hands-on scoping workshop?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note — we have an executive review that overlapped the demo slot we booked for Apr 15, and the platform team would prefer to use that time instead to run a hands-on technical scoping session (POC-style) so we can validate integration points and data access up front.

High level: can we convert the 60-min intro demo into a 2.5–3 hour engineering scoping workshop? We want to include our infra lead (Tom), two platform engineers, and one data engineer. We’ll bring our sample payloads and access to a staging bucket.

Rough windows that work for us next week: Apr 20 between 09:00–12:00 PT, or Apr 21 between 13:00–17:00 PT. If those don’t work, we can propose alternatives. Also, please confirm whether you can run the workshop with a short prework checklist (data sample, S3 credentials pattern, and preferred model/latency expectations).

Thanks — sorry for the late change, we thought the exec block might clear but it didn’t.

—Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Senior Manager, Platform
Acme Systems

Subject: Re: Change of plan — can we convert intro demo into a hands-on scoping workshop?

Hi Sarah —

Totally understand, thanks for the heads up. We can definitely convert this to a technical scoping workshop and accommodate a longer block. High-level options based on team availability:

- Tue Apr 20, 09:00–12:00 PT (3h) — good for Marcus to lead the integration section
- Wed Apr 21, 13:00–16:00 PT (3h) — Karthik would run model/latency tuning and runtime setup

If you prefer a 2.5h cadence we can compress the agenda; typically we keep 30 mins for exec/context, 90–120 mins for hands-on lab with a 30 min wrap-up. I’ll attach a draft agenda and a short prework checklist for your engineers so they can bring sample inputs and minimal IAM creds for staging access.

We can also discuss a private VPC/test tenancy (Private deployment) if you need strictly isolated networking for the POC — let us know and I’ll pull in Solutions Engineering.

Please confirm the preferred date and number of attendees and we’ll lock the calendar.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scoping-agenda-v2.pdf (draft), prework-checklist.md

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick reply. Wed Apr 21, 13:00–16:00 PT works best for our group, but could we compress to 13:00–15:30 PT (2.5h)? We want to keep ~30 minutes at the top for an exec overview and the rest focused on the hands-on lab.

Attendees: Tom Li (Lead, Platform), Priya Patel (Data Eng), Marcus Alvarez (Platform Eng). We’ll need instructions for the prework checklist — specifically what sample files (format/size) and what minimal IAM/key pattern you need. Also, we’re evaluating Private deployment for compliance — can someone confirm if demonstrating a VPC-hosted POC is feasible in the workshop timeframe?

If that schedule works, I’ll ask our EA to look out for the calendar invite and confirm guest list.

—Sarah
